title: plugin-detail: a `record:details` node with no `sections` renders an empty body, though the spec declares that omitting `sections` falls back to the object's `highlightFields`; the served approval-request page's Details tab is blank
body:
Filing gate **① a measured defect, class b (a declared behaviour the renderer does not honour)**. It comes from the objectui#12045 dev's report on PR #12432, measured on a real `RecordDetailView`.

- **Filed by:** objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560) · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. ⛔ Not a claim; triage grades and routes it.
- `reach:` a named producer, objectstack `plugin-approvals`' served `sys_approval_request_detail` page. Its Details tab is a bare `{ type: 'record:details' }`, so every approver who opens an approval request sees an empty Details tab: no request fields and no target-record card. The same holds for any page an author or AI writes with a bare `record:details`.

## The declaration

`@objectstack/spec` `ui/component.zod.ts`, the `record:details` retired-`layout` entry, read on objectstack `main` (both the TSDoc and the refusal text the spec serves):

> `sections` renders the explicit groups (the old `custom`), and omitting it falls back to the object's `highlightFields` (the old `auto`).

The served page's own comment expects the same tab to show "the request's own fields by the object's field groups" (`sys-approval-request.page.ts:35`–`:36`).

## What objectui does

A `record:details` node with no `sections` and no `fields` renders one empty `space-y-6` div: neither the `highlightFields` fallback the spec declares nor the object's field groups. Measured by the #12045 dev on a real `RecordDetailView` mount of the served page's shape.

So on the served request page:
- the A2 record-pointer card for `record_id`, which the details grid is where `record_id` was meant to draw, is drawn nowhere;
- every request field outside the highlights strip is drawn nowhere.

## For the claimant

- **Seam:** `spec:RecordDetailsProps.sections` (omitted) → `renderer:` plugin-detail's `record:details` renderer.
  - Per the base principle, a declared fallback that the renderer does not honour is an implementation gap: build it, ⛔ do not narrow at the consumer.
  - Whether the fallback reads `highlightFields` (the spec's words) or the object's field groups (the page comment's words) is the spec's text to settle. The spec's sentence governs unless the spec seat says otherwise.
- **Hidden-field caution:**
  - If the answer draws the object's field groups, `sys_approval_request`'s State group carries `payload_json` and `node_config_json`. Those must not reach a business approver as raw text; the inbox gates its raw-payload panel to `studio.access` (objectui#5553).
  - The `highlightFields` route avoids that, because the details grid already hides the fields the strip shows.

Dedupe: semantic search over objectui issues, closed included, for `record:details` no sections, empty body, `highlightFields` fallback: 0 matching (the nearest, objectui#7064 and objectui#12348, are about `hideEmpty`).
